library:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop application UI design, 1600x1000 landscape composition
Primary request: Design the main media-library screen of TimesFrame, a Chinese-language Windows/macOS desktop app for uploading and managing photos and videos on a Divoom AstroToo LAN photo frame.
Style/medium: polished realistic flat desktop app screenshot, warm light background, white panels, subtle gray borders, restrained blue primary actions, crisp readable Chinese typography, practical and elegant spacing.
Composition: single complete desktop window, title TimesFrame at top left. Left sidebar with connected device card "AstroToo" and "480 × 480", green connection status, "刷新设备", albums "全部照片", "家庭", "旅行", "收藏". Main area title "旅行", toolbar with "全部" "照片" "视频", "导入照片和视频" primary button, gallery grid of square landscape/family/travel photo thumbnails and some video tiles with duration badges. Selected tile with small checkbox. Bottom upload queue drawer with two thumbnail rows, conversion and upload progress bars. Modest right details panel shows selected video preview, filename, resolution and duration, and actions "移出相簿" "彻底删除".
Constraints: title must be TimesFrame, Chinese labels, shows device-provided target size, video uploads include cover previews, video limit "最长 30 分钟"; use actual attractive photo imagery inside thumbnails; avoid excessive decorative graphics, avoid code or protocol names in UI, avoid device hardware rendering outside app. Flat front-facing screenshot, not a perspective mockup.
editor:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity TimesFrame desktop media crop editor screenshot, landscape 1600x1000 composition.
Primary request: a polished practical light Chinese-language photo and video cropping screen matching a white, soft-gray, blue-action desktop media-library application named TimesFrame.
Composition: one flat complete desktop window. Top bar title "TimesFrame" and "编辑视频", back action "返回相簿". Large central source video preview of a family walking along a beach, with a clear square crop boundary, rule-of-thirds guides, dimmed outside area and draggable corner handles. Right control panel title "裁剪与导出", device "AstroToo", target "480 × 480", source information, zoom slider, rotate button, reset button, smaller square final-output preview, and video-cover frame preview labeled "视频预览图". Bottom center timeline with frame thumbnails and two trim handles, play control, current time and duration. Start input "00:00" end "00:28". Text "最长 30 分钟" and "同时上传视频和预览图". Bottom right prominent blue action "保存并加入上传队列", secondary "取消". No protocol names, codec strings or irrelevant decorative graphics in the product UI. Ensure visual hierarchy and readable Chinese labels, comfortable whitespace, native desktop affordances. This is a UI mockup not a perspective device photo.
